description: Expander for MIDI-CAT, placed immediately to the right of it, storing one MIDI mapping for each type of module so a mapping can be recalled without being made again.

params.text: Turns the cursor into a crosshair; clicking a module loads the stored mapping for that type of module into MIDI-CAT.
Scans the patch backwards and applies the stored mapping of the previous module that has one.
Scans the patch forwards and applies the stored mapping of the next module that has one.

inputs.text: A trigger applies the stored mapping of the previous module in the patch that has one.
A trigger applies the stored mapping of the next module in the patch that has one.

notes: the stored mappings are held in this module, so exporting its preset carries them to other patches.
one mapping is held per type of module, and storing a second for the same type replaces the first.
menu: Store mapping — on MIDI-CAT's own context menu, under MEM-expander, saving the mapping now in MIDI-CAT under the type of module it was made for; Delete removes a stored one.
Restriction — on MIDI-CAT's own context menu, under MEM-expander: Save selection limits which modules the scanning buttons consider, Show marks them, and Clear empties the list.
Available mappings — on MIDI-CAT's own context menu, under MEM-expander, listing every stored mapping by module type.
Apply mapping — on MIDI-CAT's own context menu, under MEM-expander, or Shift and V while the pointer is over MIDI-CAT.

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
